summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp. (Nasdaq: HYFT), a British Columbia-domiciled foreign private issuer formerly ImmunoPrecise Antibodies, furnished a Form 6-K with an earnings release dated September 14, 2026, covering fiscal Q1 2027 ended July 31, 2026. Revenue rose 21.3% to C$3.8M, gross margin expanded to 58.6%, net loss from continuing operations widened to C$6.1M (C$0.13/share), and the ReefIQ data platform commercially launched. Management also disclosed a binding commitment for a US$30M senior unsecured revolving credit facility at a fixed 7.00% rate. This is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure, not a special situation; the facility is an ordinary credit agreement. Watch operating cash burn and enterprise conversion.
